about: Unpopular Opinion Puffin is an old advice animal built on a photo of an Atlantic puffin on a patch of grass, mid-step with one bright orange foot lifted high, as if it is strutting away from an argument it just started. The bird confidently says out loud the takes that most people would keep to themselves: that a beloved movie is boring, that pineapple belongs on pizza, that summer is the worst season. The comedy is in the cheerful, oblivious walk paired with an opinion guaranteed to start fights in the comments.
origin: The puffin became one of the Reddit advice animals in the early 2010s, joining the wave of single-animal image macros that each had a fixed personality. Its role was always the same: voice opinions that go against the crowd.
usage:
Split the opinion over both boxes. The top box sets up the thing everyone loves, and the bottom box delivers the unpopular verdict. Example: "I don't find Mitch Hedberg" / "all that funny".

The best captions are genuinely contrarian but harmless, the kind of take that gets a laugh and a hundred replies. Pick something widely liked (a classic film, a holiday, a famous snack) and dismiss it in as few words as possible. Avoid opinions that are actually hurtful; the puffin works because the stakes are tiny.
